question: Who among the following founded the Widow Re-Marriage Association?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Vishnu Shastri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Vishnu Shastri** was a **great advocate** of **women's rights** and worked towards their **empowerment.**
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy, Swami Vivekananda, and Keshab Chandra Sen** were also **social reformers **who worked towards the upliftment of women and the** abolition of social evils.**
 
• However, the founding of the **Widow Re-Marriage Association** specifically is credited to Pandit Vishnu Shastri in **Bombay in 1854.**
 
• This association aimed to promote the** remarriage of widows**, which was a **taboo** in Indian society at the time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy **was a social reformer who worked towards **abolishing Sati **and promoting **women's education.**
 
• **Swami Vivekananda **was a disciple of** Ramakrishna Paramahamsa** and a great preacher of** Vedanta philosophy.**
